title: CASE-07 — Not yet due: get paid early while the buyer still has 2 days to pay
note: INPUT ONLY, synthetic (golden rule 11): no real parties, Udyam or GSTIN numbers. No outputs are stored here; every number comes from the engine. This case exists to show Option 1: the invoice is delivered and accepted, the due date is still ahead, and nothing has been objected to, so financing is available.
why_calculation_date: Deliberate: delivery 2026-09-28 plus 30 agreed days puts the due date on 2026-10-28, two days after the 2026-10-26 calculation date. The appointed day is 2026-10-29, so no day of delay has accrued and s.16 interest is zero until then - which is exactly why Get paid early is available on this invoice and Recover with the law is not yet the interesting option. Not overdue is required: financing.max_overdue_days is 0 (OQ-11), so an overdue invoice can never be financed.
